cafeVisualAudit.imageImplementationDetails: NO food photographs found (0 tags). Product cards exclusively use Unicode emoji glyphs (☕ 🧊 ☕ 🍸 in 16 .item-icon containers).
cafeVisualAudit.productCardQuality: Found 16 product cards. Structured with flex column, border-radius (16px), box-shadow, badge tags, and hover translateY effect.
cafeVisualAudit.typography: Serif headings: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif (Playfair Display/Georgia); Body copy: Outfit, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif (Outfit/system-ui). Clean typographic hierarchy.
cafeVisualAudit.spacing: Grid gap 24px, container max-width 1320px with 24px padding. Card internal padding 20px with 14px bottom divider.

cafeVisualAudit.checkoutDesign: Modal overlay with backdrop blur, centered ticket card, monospace receipt ticket number (#AO-XXXXXX), and customer details.
cafeVisualAudit.emptyAndErrorStates: Zero-result search renders custom dashed empty state ("No menu items matched your search"). Empty cart shows cart illustration. Empty name on checkout highlights red input border.
